Alabama.eviction_notice: 30 days to end month-to-month; 7 business days to pay or vacate for nonpayment
Alabama.first_offense: Up to 1 year in jail (no mandatory jail time), $600-$2,100 fine, 90-day license suspension
Alabama.repair_rights: No repair-and-deduct and no rent withholding allowed; may terminate the lease after 14 days' written notice if the landlord doesn't fix the problem
Alabama.security_deposit: Max 1 month's rent (extra allowed for pets, alterations, or added liability); return within 60 days with a written itemized list

Alaska.eviction_notice: 30 days to end month-to-month; 7 days to pay or quit for nonpayment
Alaska.first_offense: Minimum 72 hours in jail, $1,500 minimum fine, 90-day license revocation
Alaska.repair_rights: May repair and deduct actual reasonable costs for essential services (heat, water, etc.) after giving written notice
Alaska.security_deposit: Max 2 months' rent (no cap if rent is over $2,000/month); return within 14 days if proper move-out notice was given, 30 days otherwise; itemized list required

Arizona.bac_limit: 0.08; extreme DUI at 0.15, super extreme DUI at 0.20
Arizona.eviction_notice: 30 days to end month-to-month; 5 days to pay or quit for nonpayment
Arizona.first_offense: Minimum 10 days jail (9 days can be suspended), $1,250+ fine, 90-day license suspension
Arizona.repair_rights: May repair and deduct after 10 days' written notice for minor defects, capped at $300 or half a month's rent (whichever is greater)
Arizona.security_deposit: Max 1.5 months' rent; return within 14 days (excluding weekends/holidays) with an itemized list

Arkansas.eviction_notice: 30 days to end month-to-month; 3-day notice to quit for nonpayment (civil eviction)
Arkansas.first_offense: 24 hours to 1 year in jail (community service may substitute), $150-$1,000 fine, 6-month license suspension
Arkansas.repair_rights: No repair-and-deduct and no rent withholding; tenant may cancel the rental agreement 30 days after written notice of an unrepaired required issue
Arkansas.security_deposit: Max 2 months' rent (deposit law applies to landlords with 6+ units or who use a property manager); return within 60 days with a written itemized list

California.eviction_notice: 3-day notice to pay or quit for nonpayment; 30 days to end month-to-month if tenant has been there under 1 year, 60 days if 1 year or more
California.first_offense: Up to 6 months in jail (48-hour minimum in some counties), $390-$1,000 fine, 6-month license suspension
California.repair_rights: May repair and deduct up to 1 month's rent after reasonable written notice (Civil Code 1942)
California.security_deposit: Max 1 month's rent (2 months' rent allowed for small landlords with no more than 2 properties/4 units); return within 21 days with a written itemized list

Colorado.eviction_notice: 21 days to end month-to-month if tenancy under 1 year, 91 days if 1 year or more; 10-day notice to pay or quit for nonpayment
Colorado.first_offense: 5 days to 1 year in jail, $600-$1,000 fine, 9-month license revocation
Colorado.repair_rights: May repair and deduct reasonable costs after written notice under the warranty of habitability (10 days' notice; 48 hours for health/safety emergencies)
Colorado.security_deposit: Max 2 months' rent; return within 1 month (lease may extend the deadline up to 60 days) with a written itemized list

Connecticut.eviction_notice: 3-day notice to quit for nonpayment (after the 9-day grace period); 3-day notice to quit to end a month-to-month tenancy
Connecticut.first_offense: Up to 6 months in jail (48 hours mandatory or 100 hours community service option), $500-$1,000 fine, 45-day license suspension
Connecticut.repair_rights: May procure essential services/repairs and deduct actual reasonable cost after written notice; rent escrow available through Housing Court
Connecticut.security_deposit: Max 2 months' rent (1 month's rent if tenant is 62 or older); return within 30 days with an itemized list

Delaware.eviction_notice: 60 days to end month-to-month; 5-day notice to pay for nonpayment
Delaware.first_offense: Up to 12 months in jail, $500-$1,500 fine, 12-month license revocation
Delaware.lookback: 10 years for a second offense; lifetime for third and later
Delaware.repair_rights: May repair and deduct up to $400 or half a month's rent (whichever is less) after written notice
Delaware.security_deposit: Max 1 month's rent for tenancies of 1 year or longer (no cap for furnished units); return within 20 days with an itemized list

Florida.eviction_notice: 15 days to end month-to-month; 3-day notice to pay or vacate for nonpayment
Florida.first_offense: Up to 6 months in jail, $500-$1,000 fine, 6-month to 1-year license revocation
Florida.lookback: 5 years for second-offense enhancements, 10 years for third, lifetime for fourth
Florida.repair_rights: No general repair-and-deduct statute; may terminate the lease or withhold rent after 7 days' written notice for the landlord's failure to maintain
Florida.security_deposit: No statutory maximum; return within 15 days if no deductions, otherwise 30 days' written notice of intent to impose a claim on the deposit

Georgia.eviction_notice: 60 days to end month-to-month; no statutory cure period for nonpayment - landlord makes a demand, then files a dispossessory action
Georgia.first_offense: 24 hours to 12 months in jail, $300-$1,000 fine, up to 1-year license suspension
Georgia.repair_rights: May repair and deduct reasonable cost after written notice and a reasonable time for the landlord to fix
Georgia.security_deposit: No statutory maximum; return within 30 days with an itemized list

Hawaii.eviction_notice: 45 days written notice to end month-to-month; 15-day notice to pay or quit for nonpayment (mediation required)
Hawaii.first_offense: 2-5 days jail, $250-$1,000 fine, 1-18 month license revocation
Hawaii.repair_rights: May repair and deduct after written notice (cap $500, or $500/one month's rent with two written estimates)
Hawaii.security_deposit: Max 1 month's rent; returned within 14 days with itemized deduction list

Idaho.eviction_notice: 30 days (one month) to end month-to-month; 3-day notice to pay or quit for nonpayment
Idaho.first_offense: Up to 6 months jail, up to $1,000 fine, 90-180 day license suspension
Idaho.repair_rights: No repair-and-deduct statute (smoke-detector installation exception only)
Idaho.security_deposit: No cap; returned within 21 days (30 if lease allows); itemized deduction list required

Illinois.bac_limit: 0.08; enhanced penalties at 0.16 (100 hrs community service)
Illinois.eviction_notice: 30 days to end month-to-month; 5-day notice to pay or quit for nonpayment
Illinois.first_offense: Up to 1 year jail, up to $2,500 fine, 6-month license suspension (12 months if test refused)
Illinois.lookback: Lifetime (DUI cannot be expunged or sealed)
Illinois.repair_rights: May repair and deduct after written notice (cap $500 or half month's rent)
Illinois.security_deposit: No statewide cap (Chicago/Cook County have own rules); returned within 45 days, itemized statement within 30 days if deductions

Indiana.eviction_notice: 30 days to end month-to-month; 10-day notice to pay or quit for nonpayment
Indiana.first_offense: Up to 60 days jail, up to $500 fine, up to 2-year license suspension
Indiana.lookback: Lifetime (priors count forever; felony enhancements within 7 years)
Indiana.repair_rights: No repair-and-deduct statute (tenant may sue for repairs, damages, and attorney fees)
Indiana.security_deposit: No cap; returned within 45 days; itemized deduction list required

Iowa.eviction_notice: 30 days to end month-to-month; 3-day notice to pay or quit for nonpayment
Iowa.first_offense: 48 hours-1 year jail, up to $1,250 fine, 180-day license revocation
Iowa.repair_rights: May repair and deduct after 7-day written notice (cap: one month's rent)
Iowa.security_deposit: Max 2 months' rent; returned within 30 days with written itemized statement

Kansas.bac_limit: 0.08; enhanced penalties at 0.15 (1-year suspension + 1-year IID restriction)
Kansas.eviction_notice: 30 days to end month-to-month; 3-day notice to pay or quit for nonpayment
Kansas.first_offense: 48 hours-6 months jail, $750-$1,000 fine, 30-day suspension + 180-day restricted driving
Kansas.repair_rights: No repair-and-deduct statute (may terminate lease after written notice and 14 days to fix)
Kansas.security_deposit: Max 1 month's rent (1.5 months furnished, +0.5 month pet deposit); returned within 30 days with itemized written notice

Kentucky.bac_limit: 0.08; aggravating threshold at 0.15 (mandatory minimum jail even on first offense)
Kentucky.eviction_notice: 30 days to end month-to-month; 7-day notice to pay or quit for nonpayment
Kentucky.first_offense: 2-30 days jail, $200-$500 fine, about 6-month license suspension
Kentucky.repair_rights: May repair and deduct after 14-day written notice (cap $100 or half month's rent) - URLTA jurisdictions only
Kentucky.security_deposit: No cap; 30-60 day return timeline depending on circumstances; itemized damage list required

Louisiana.bac_limit: 0.08; enhanced penalties at 0.15 (fines and 2-year suspension; mandatory jail at 0.20)
Louisiana.eviction_notice: 10 days to end month-to-month; 5-day notice to vacate before filing (no statutory right to cure)
Louisiana.first_offense: 10 days-6 months jail, $300-$1,000 fine, up to 90-day license suspension
Louisiana.lookback: 10-year lookback (cleansing period; priors older than 10 years don't enhance)
Louisiana.repair_rights: May repair and deduct for health/safety issues after notice, or end the lease
Louisiana.security_deposit: No cap; returned within 1 month with itemized list of deductions

Maine.eviction_notice: 30 days to end tenancy at will; 7-day notice for nonpayment
Maine.first_offense: Up to 364 days jail, $500+ fine, 150-day license suspension
Maine.repair_rights: May repair and deduct after 14-day written notice by certified mail (cap $500 or half month's rent)
Maine.security_deposit: Max 2 months' rent; returned within 30 days (21 days for tenancy at will) with itemized list

Maryland.bac_limit: 0.08; enhanced penalties at 0.15 (plus minor-passenger and other aggravators)
Maryland.eviction_notice: 30 days to end month-to-month; 10-day notice for nonpayment
Maryland.first_offense: Up to 1 year jail, up to $1,000 fine, 6-month license suspension (IID required)
Maryland.repair_rights: No repair-and-deduct statute; rent escrow through district court allowed
Maryland.security_deposit: Max 1 month's rent (2 months if utility agreement in writing); returned within 45 days with itemized list

Massachusetts.eviction_notice: 30 days to end a month-to-month (tenancy at will); 14-day notice to pay or vacate for nonpayment
Massachusetts.first_offense: up to 2.5 years in jail, $500-$5,000 fine, 1-year license suspension
Massachusetts.repair_rights: may repair and deduct after written notice and reasonable time
Massachusetts.security_deposit: 1 month's rent maximum; returned within 30 days with an itemized list of deductions

Michigan.eviction_notice: one rental period (typically 30 days) to end month-to-month; 7-day notice to pay or vacate for nonpayment
Michigan.first_offense: up to 93 days in jail, $100-$500 fine, 30-day suspension plus 150 days restricted driving
Michigan.repair_rights: no broad repair-and-deduct right for residential tenants; rent escrow and court remedies allowed
Michigan.security_deposit: 1.5 months' rent maximum; returned within 30 days with an itemized list of deductions

Minnesota.eviction_notice: one full rental period (one month) to end month-to-month; 14-day notice for nonpayment
Minnesota.first_offense: up to 90 days in jail, up to $1,000 fine, 90-day license revocation
Minnesota.repair_rights: rent escrow allowed; repair-and-deduct only with a court order
Minnesota.security_deposit: no statutory maximum; returned within 21 days with an itemized list of deductions

Mississippi.eviction_notice: 30 days to end month-to-month; 3-day notice to pay or vacate for nonpayment
Mississippi.first_offense: up to 48 hours in jail, $250-$1,000 fine, 120-day license suspension
Mississippi.repair_rights: may repair and deduct after written notice and 30 days
Mississippi.security_deposit: no statutory maximum; returned within 45 days with an itemized list of deductions

Missouri.eviction_notice: 1 month's written notice to end month-to-month; landlord must make a written demand for rent before filing eviction for nonpayment
Missouri.first_offense: up to 6 months in jail, up to $1,000 fine, 90-day license suspension
Missouri.repair_rights: may repair and deduct after 14 days' written notice (cost up to 1 month's rent)
Missouri.security_deposit: 2 months' rent maximum; returned within 30 days with an itemized list of deductions

Montana.eviction_notice: 30 days to end month-to-month; 3-day notice to pay or move for nonpayment
Montana.first_offense: up to 6 months in jail (24-hour minimum), $600-$1,000 fine, up to 6-month license suspension
Montana.repair_rights: may repair and deduct after written notice
Montana.security_deposit: no statutory maximum; returned within 10 days if no deductions, otherwise 30 days with an itemized list

Nebraska.eviction_notice: 30 days to end month-to-month; 7-day notice to pay or quit for nonpayment
Nebraska.first_offense: 7-60 days in jail, $500 fine, 6-month license revocation
Nebraska.repair_rights: may procure essential services and deduct the reasonable cost after written notice
Nebraska.security_deposit: 1 month's rent maximum (plus up to 1/4 month pet deposit); returned within 14 days with an itemized list

Nevada.bac_limit: 0.08; enhanced penalties at 0.18 (treatment program ordered at 0.16)
Nevada.eviction_notice: 30 days to end month-to-month; 7-day notice to pay or quit for nonpayment
Nevada.first_offense: 2 days to 6 months in jail (or 48-96 hours community service), $400-$1,000 fine, 185-day license revocation
Nevada.repair_rights: may repair and deduct after written notice (limits apply)
Nevada.security_deposit: 3 months' rent maximum; returned within 30 days with an itemized list of deductions

New Hampshire.eviction_notice: 30 days to end month-to-month (good cause required); 7-day notice to pay or quit for nonpayment
New Hampshire.first_offense: no mandatory jail (up to 12 months possible), $500+ fine, 9-month license revocation
New Hampshire.repair_rights: no repair-and-deduct statute; tenant may pay rent into court or terminate after notice
New Hampshire.security_deposit: $100 or 1 month's rent maximum (whichever is greater); returned within 30 days with an itemized list

New Jersey.eviction_notice: no pre-filing notice required for nonpayment; generally 30 days' notice to end month-to-month, with good cause required in covered units
New Jersey.first_offense: up to 30 days in jail, $250-$400 fine, 3-month suspension (plus ignition interlock) for BAC 0.08-0.10
New Jersey.repair_rights: repair-and-deduct recognized by case law after notice
New Jersey.security_deposit: 1.5 months' rent maximum; returned within 30 days with an itemized list of deductions

New Mexico.eviction_notice: 30 days to end month-to-month; 3-day notice for nonpayment of rent
New Mexico.first_offense: Up to 90 days jail; up to $500 fine; license revocation 6-12 months
New Mexico.lookback: Lifetime (no time limit on counting prior DWI convictions)
New Mexico.repair_rights: No repair-and-deduct statute; tenant may abate rent after 7-day written notice
New Mexico.security_deposit: Max 1 month's rent for agreements under 1 year; return within 30 days of termination or move-out (whichever is later), written itemized deduction list required

New York.eviction_notice: 14-day written rent demand for nonpayment; 30/60/90 days to end tenancy depending on length of occupancy
New York.first_offense: $500-$1,000 fine; up to 1 year jail; license revocation at least 6 months
New York.repair_rights: No general repair-and-deduct; tenants may sue in housing court (HP action) to compel repairs
New York.security_deposit: Max 1 month's rent; return within 14 days of move-out, written itemized deduction list required

North Carolina.eviction_notice: 10-day notice for nonpayment; 7 days to end month-to-month
North Carolina.first_offense: Level 5: up to $200 fine; 24 hours-60 days jail; 1-year license revocation
North Carolina.repair_rights: No rent-withholding or repair-and-deduct statute; tenants may sue in small claims court for repairs and rent reduction
North Carolina.security_deposit: Max 1.5 months' rent (month-to-month); return within 30 days with written itemized list of deductions

North Dakota.bac_limit: 0.08; enhanced penalties at 0.18 (2-day mandatory jail at 0.16+)
North Dakota.eviction_notice: 3-day notice to pay or quit for nonpayment; 1 calendar month to end month-to-month
North Dakota.first_offense: Minimum $500 fine; up to 30 days jail; 91-day license suspension
North Dakota.repair_rights: May repair and deduct after written notice (N.D. Cent. Code 47-16-13)
North Dakota.security_deposit: Max 1 month's rent; return within 30 days with itemized written statement

Ohio.eviction_notice: 3-day notice to vacate for nonpayment; 30 days to end month-to-month
Ohio.first_offense: 3 days-6 months jail; $375-$1,075 fine; 1-3 year license suspension
Ohio.repair_rights: May deposit rent into court escrow after written notice to landlord; may terminate lease if repairs unmade
Ohio.security_deposit: No maximum limit; return within 30 days with itemized written statement

Oklahoma.eviction_notice: 5-day written demand for nonpayment; 30 days to end month-to-month
Oklahoma.first_offense: 10 days-1 year jail; up to $1,000 fine; up to 180-day license revocation
Oklahoma.repair_rights: May repair and deduct (up to 1 month's rent) after 14-day written notice
Oklahoma.security_deposit: No maximum limit; return within 45 days after termination, possession, and written demand, with itemized statement

Oregon.eviction_notice: 72-hour notice to pay for nonpayment (144 hours if served earlier); 30 days to end month-to-month (60 days after 1 year)
Oregon.first_offense: 48 hours-1 year jail; $1,000-$6,250 fine; 1-year license suspension
Oregon.lookback: Lifetime (priors count regardless of age; felony threshold uses 10-year window)
Oregon.repair_rights: May repair and deduct up to $300 for minor habitability defects after 7-day written notice (ORS 90.368)
Oregon.security_deposit: No statewide maximum; return within 31 days with written accounting

Pennsylvania.eviction_notice: 10-day notice for nonpayment; 15 days to end month-to-month
Pennsylvania.first_offense: General impairment: up to 6 months probation, $300 fine, no jail; high BAC: 48 hours-6 months jail, $500-$5,000 fine, 12-month license suspension
Pennsylvania.repair_rights: Limited right to withhold rent or repair and deduct under court doctrine (Pugh v. Holmes); risky without legal advice
Pennsylvania.security_deposit: Max 2 months' rent first year, 1 month thereafter; return within 30 days with written itemized list

Rhode Island.eviction_notice: 5-day demand for nonpayment (after 15-day grace); 30 days to end month-to-month
Rhode Island.first_offense: $100-$300 fine; 10-60 hours community service (up to 1 year jail possible); 30-180 day license suspension
Rhode Island.repair_rights: May repair and deduct after notice; tenant must keep itemized list of expenses (R.I. Gen. Laws 34-18-30)
Rhode Island.security_deposit: Max 1 month's rent; return within 20 days with itemized written list

South Carolina.eviction_notice: 5-day written notice for nonpayment; 30 days to end month-to-month
South Carolina.first_offense: $400 fine; 48 hours-30 days jail; 6-month license suspension
South Carolina.repair_rights: May terminate lease after 14-day written notice of noncompliance; no general repair-and-deduct (may procure essential services and deduct cost)
South Carolina.security_deposit: No maximum limit; return within 30 days with written itemized list of deductions

South Dakota.eviction_notice: 3-day notice to pay or vacate for nonpayment; 30 days to end a month-to-month tenancy
South Dakota.first_offense: Up to 1 year in jail, up to $2,000 fine, 30-day to 1-year license revocation (no mandatory jail)
South Dakota.repair_rights: No repair-and-deduct statute; habitability claims enforced through court action
South Dakota.security_deposit: Max 1 month's rent; return within 2 weeks; written itemized statement of deductions required

Tennessee.bac_limit: 0.08; enhanced penalties at 0.15 (threshold lowered from 0.20 in July 2024)
Tennessee.eviction_notice: 14-day notice to pay or quit for nonpayment (URLTA counties); 30 days to end a month-to-month tenancy
Tennessee.first_offense: 48 hours to 11 months 29 days in jail, $350 to $1,500 fine, 1-year license revocation
Tennessee.repair_rights: Limited repair-and-deduct for essential services after written notice; otherwise tenant may terminate lease or go to court
Tennessee.security_deposit: No statewide cap; return within 30 days; itemized list of deductions required

Texas.bac_limit: 0.08; enhanced charge at BAC 0.15 or higher (Class A misdemeanor)
Texas.eviction_notice: 3-day notice to vacate for nonpayment; 30 days to end a month-to-month tenancy
Texas.first_offense: 72 hours to 180 days in jail, up to $2,000 fine, license suspension up to 1 year
Texas.repair_rights: May repair and deduct up to 1 month's rent or $500 after written notice
Texas.security_deposit: No statutory cap; return within 30 days; written itemized list required

Utah.eviction_notice: 3-business-day notice to pay or vacate for nonpayment; 15 days to end a month-to-month tenancy
Utah.first_offense: 48 hours to 6 months in jail (or 48 hours community service), fines $700 and up, 120-day license suspension
Utah.repair_rights: May repair and deduct up to 2 months' rent after written notice under the Fit Premises Act; rent abatement remedy also available
Utah.security_deposit: No statutory cap; return within 30 days (or 15 days after forwarding address provided); itemized statement required

Vermont.eviction_notice: 14-day notice to pay or quit for nonpayment; 60 days to end a month-to-month tenancy without cause (90 days if tenancy lasted 2+ years)
Vermont.first_offense: Up to 2 years in jail, up to $750 fine, 90-day license suspension (no mandatory jail)
Vermont.repair_rights: May repair minor defects and deduct up to half a month's rent after 30 days' written notice; rent withholding allowed for major code violations
Vermont.security_deposit: No statewide cap; return within 14 days; written itemized statement required

Virginia.bac_limit: 0.08; mandatory jail at 0.15 to 0.20 (5 days) or over 0.20 (10 days)
Virginia.eviction_notice: 14-day notice to pay or quit for nonpayment (increased from 5 days effective July 1, 2026); 30 days to end a month-to-month tenancy
Virginia.first_offense: Up to 12 months in jail, $250 to $2,500 fine, 1-year license revocation, VASAP program required
Virginia.repair_rights: May hire a third-party contractor and deduct up to $1,500 or 1 month's rent after 14 days' written notice
Virginia.security_deposit: Max 2 months' rent; return within 45 days; itemized list required

Washington.eviction_notice: 14-day notice to pay or vacate for nonpayment; 20 days to end a month-to-month tenancy
Washington.first_offense: 24 hours to 364 days in jail, fines roughly $990 to $5,000, 90-day license suspension
Washington.repair_rights: May repair and deduct up to 2 months' rent after written notice and estimate (1 month's rent if doing the work personally)
Washington.security_deposit: No statutory cap; return within 21 days; written itemized statement required

West Virginia.eviction_notice: No statutory notice period for eviction; notice governed by lease terms (month-to-month termination requires 1 full rental period's notice)
West Virginia.first_offense: Up to 6 months in jail (24 hours mandatory), $100 to $500 fine, 15-day license suspension plus 6 months ignition interlock
West Virginia.repair_rights: No repair-and-deduct statute; courts recognize rent withholding until landlord makes habitability repairs
West Virginia.security_deposit: No statutory cap; return within 60 days (or 45 days after a new tenant occupies); itemized written statement required

Wisconsin.eviction_notice: 5-day notice to pay or vacate for nonpayment (14-day no-cure notice on repeat default within 12 months); 28 days to end a month-to-month tenancy
Wisconsin.first_offense: $150 to $300 fine, no jail, 6 to 9 month license revocation
Wisconsin.repair_rights: No repair-and-deduct statute; rent abatement remedy for unfit conditions after notice and inspection process
Wisconsin.security_deposit: No statutory cap; return within 21 days; written itemized statement required

Wyoming.bac_limit: 0.08; enhanced penalties at 0.15 (6-month ignition interlock requirement)
Wyoming.eviction_notice: 3-day notice to pay or vacate for nonpayment or lease violations; 30 days to end a month-to-month tenancy
Wyoming.first_offense: Up to 6 months in jail, up to $750 fine, 90-day license suspension (mandatory minimum jail now applies)
Wyoming.repair_rights: No repair-and-deduct statute; tenant may sue in circuit court for repairs after written notice
Wyoming.security_deposit: No statutory cap; return within 30 days (or 15 days after new address received); written itemized list required
